data.title: Medicare Durable Medical Equipment, Devices & Supplies - by Supplier and Service Data Dictionary

fields.name: Suplr_NPI
fields.label: Supplier NPI
fields.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) for the supplying provider on the DMEPOS claim.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Last_Name_Org
fields.label: Supplier Provider Last Name / Organization Name
fields.description: When the supplier is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the supplier’s last name. When the supplier is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this is the organization name.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_First_Name
fields.label: Supplier Provider First Name
fields.description: When the supplier is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the supplier’s first name. When the supplier is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_MI
fields.label: Supplier Provider Middle Initial
fields.description: When the supplier is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), this is the supplier’s middle initial. When the supplier is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Crdntls
fields.label: Supplier Credentials
fields.description: When the supplier is registered in NPPES as an individual (entity type code=’I’), these are the supplier’s credentials. When the supplier is registered as an organization (entity type code = ‘O’), this will be blank.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Ent_Cd
fields.label: Supplier Entity Code
fields.description: Type of entity reported in NPPES. An entity code of ‘I’ identifies suppliers registered as individuals and an entity type code of ‘O’ identifies suppliers registered as organizations.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_St1
fields.label: Supplier Provider Street 1
fields.description: The first line of the supplier’s street address, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_St2
fields.label: Supplier Provider Street 2
fields.description: The second line of the supplier’s street address, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_City
fields.label: Supplier Provider City
fields.description: The city where the supplier is located, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_State_Abrvtn
fields.label: Supplier Provider State
fields.description:
The state where the supplier is located, as reported in NPPES. The fifty U.S. states and the District of Columbia are reported by the state postal abbreviation. The following values are used for other areas:

'XX' = 'Unknown', 'AA' = 'Armed Forces Central/South America', 'AE' = 'Armed Forces Europe', 'AP' = 'Armed Forces Pacific'
'AS' = 'American Samoa', 'GU' = 'Guam', 'MP' = 'North Mariana Islands', 'PR' = 'Puerto Rico', 'VI' = 'Virgin Islands'
'ZZ' = 'Foreign Country'

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_State_FIPS
fields.label: Supplier Provider State FIPS Code
fields.description: FIPS code for suppliers state.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Zip5
fields.label: Supplier Provider ZIP
fields.description: The supplier’s ZIP code, as reported in NPPES.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_RUCA_CAT
fields.label: Supplier Provider RUCA Category
fields.description: Urban-rural designation based on RUCA codes.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_RUCA
fields.label: Supplier Provider RUCA
fields.description: Rural-Urban Commuting Area Codes (RUCAs), are a Census tract-based classification scheme that utilizes the standard Bureau of Census Urbanized Area and Urban Cluster definitions in combination with work commuting information to characterize all of the nation's Census tracts regarding their rural and urban status and relationships. The supplier ZIP code was cross walked to the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) 2010 Rural-Urban Commuting Area Codes (https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/rural-urban-commuting-area-codes…).

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_RUCA_Desc
fields.label: Supplier Provider RUCA Description
fields.description: Description of Rural-Urban Commuting Area (RUCA) Code

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Cntry
fields.label: Supplier Provider Country
fields.description: The country where the supplier is located, as reported in NPPES. The country code will be ‘US’ for any state or U.S. possession.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Spclty_Cd
fields.label: Supplier Provider Specialty Code
fields.description: Derived from the Medicare provider/supplier specialty code reported on all of the NPI's Part B non-institutional claims (DMEPOS & non-DMEPOS). For suppliers that have more than one Medicare specialty code reported on their claims, the Medicare specialty code associated with the largest number of services was used. Where a prescriber's NPI did not have associated Part B claims, the taxonomy code associated with the NPI in NPPES was mapped to a Medicare specialty code using an external crosswalk published here: https://data.cms.gov/beta/provider-characteristics/medicare-provider-su…. For any taxonomy codes that could not be mapped to a Medicare specialty code, the taxonomy classification description was used.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Spclty_Desc
fields.label: Supplier Provider Specialty Description
fields.description: Description for Rfrg_Prvdr_Spclty_Cd.

fields.name: Suplr_Prvdr_Spclty_Srce
fields.label: Supplier Provider Specialty Source
fields.description: A variable that indicates the source of the supplier Specialty.  The values are claims-specialty or NPPES-specialty

fields.name: RBCS_Lvl
fields.label: RBCS Level
fields.description: High level grouping of the Restructured BETOS Classification System (RBCS) identifier into three groups including Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetic and Orthotic Devices, and Drugs and Nutritional Products.

fields.name: RBCS_Id
fields.label: RBCS ID
fields.description: RBCS identifier which is comprised of 6 characters. The first character identifies the category; the second character identifies the subcategory; the third, fourth, and fifth characters identify the family, and the sixth character identifies whether the service is a major procedure.

fields.name: RBCS_Desc
fields.label: RBCS Description
fields.description: A concatenation of the RBCS category and RBCS subcategory description.

fields.name: HCPCS_CD
fields.label: HCPCS Code
fields.description: HCPCS code for the specific product or service furnished by the DMEPOS supplier. Beginning with calendar year 2015 data, oral cancer drugs billed by providers using the national drug code (NDC) and previously identified with HCPCS codes beginning with ‘WW’ have been re-classified to the appropriate corresponding HCPCS code beginning with ‘J’. For additional information on HCPCS codes, please visit: https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Coding/HCPCSReleaseCodeSets/Alpha-Numeric-….

fields.name: HCPCS_Desc
fields.label: HCPCS Description
fields.description: Description of the HCPCS code for the specific product or service furnished by the DMEPOS supplier.

fields.name: Suplr_Rentl_Ind
fields.label: Supplier Rental Indicator
fields.description: Identifies whether the DMEPOS product/service submitted on the supplier's claim is rental or non-rental. A value of ‘Y’ indicates rental. A value of ‘N’ indicates non-rental. The indicator is derived from either the first or second HCPCS modifier on the supplier’s claim line item having a value of ‘RR’.

fields.name: Tot_Suplr_Benes
fields.label: Number of Supplier Beneficiaries
fields.description: Number of beneficiaries associated with the supplier DMEPOS products/services ordered by the supplier. Beneficiary counts fewer than 11 have been suppressed to protect the privacy of Medicare beneficiaries.

fields.name: Tot_Suplr_Clms
fields.label: Number of Supplier Claims
fields.description: Number of DMEPOS claims submitted by the supplier, reflecting products/services ordered by the supplier. Aggregated records based on Tot_Suplr_Clms fewer than 11 are not included in the data file.

fields.name: Tot_Suplr_Srvcs
fields.label: Number of Supplier Services
fields.description: Number of DMEPOS products/services rendered by the supplier; note that the metrics used to count the number provided can vary from service to service.

fields.name: Avg_Suplr_Sbmtd_Chrg
fields.label: Average Supplier Submitted Charges
fields.description: Average of the charges that suppliers submit for DMEPOS products/services. Total submitted charges can be calculated by multiplying the Avg_Suplr_Sbmtd_Chrg byTot_Suplr_Srvcs.

fields.name: Avg_Suplr_Mdcr_Alowd_Amt
fields.label: Average Supplier Medicare Allowed Amount
fields.description: Average Medicare allowed amounts for the DMEPOS product/service rendered by suppliers. Medicare allowed amounts includes the amount Medicare pays, the deductible and coinsurance amounts that the beneficiary is responsible for paying, and any amounts that a third party is responsible for paying. Total Medicare allowed amounts can be calculated by multiplying the Avg_Suplr_Mdcr_Alowd_Amt by Tot_Suplr_Srvcs.

fields.name: Avg_Suplr_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt
fields.label: Average Supplier Medicare Payment Amount
fields.description: Average amount that Medicare paid suppliers after deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for the line item DMEPOS product/service. Total Medicare payment amounts can be calculated by multiplying the Avg_Suplr_Mdcr_Pymt_Amt by Tot_Suplr_Srvcs.

fields.name: Avg_Suplr_Mdcr_Stdzd_Amt
fields.label: Average Supplier Medicare Standard Payment Amount
fields.description: Average amount that Medicare paid after beneficiary deductible and coinsurance amounts have been deducted for the line item DMEPOS product/service and after standardization of the Medicare payment has been applied. Standardization removes geographic differences in payment rates for individual product/services and makes Medicare payments across geographic areas comparable. Note: This variable is available starting with the calendar year 2014 data.
